SelectionDecision.title: SelectionDecision
SelectionDecision.description: Which shortlisted model cross-validation chose, and why (arch doc §11, ADR-0044). The output of a select step: immutable, like every artifact. A model wins only by beating the baseline on the same folds.

folds.description: Number of cross-validation folds every candidate was scored on.

seed.description: Seed that shuffled the rows into folds.

baseline.description: The candidate every other must beat: a model that ignores its features.

winner.description: The chosen candidate. Absent: no model beats the baseline.

limitations.description: What the comparison did not cover.

SelectionMetric.description: Fixed before any score is seen: balanced_accuracy (higher is better) for classification, rmse (lower is better) for regression.

fold_scores.description: The metric on each fold's validation rows, in fold order.

spread.description: Standard deviation of the fold scores.

mean_difference.description: Mean fold-by-fold improvement over the baseline on the same folds; positive is better for either metric.

corrected_se.description: Standard error of that mean, corrected for folds that share train rows (Nadeau & Bengio 2003).

beats_baseline.description: Whether mean_difference is larger than corrected_se.
